module.purpose: Provides a deterministic conversion from a 22-byte Uint8Array into a 24-character padded base64-like nonce string for web application use.
module.summary: This module defines a base64 alphabet and exposes a synchronous transformation that validates a 22-byte input, masks each byte into base64-compatible values, applies a narrower mask to the final two bytes, and appends two padding characters. Invalid-length input produces an empty string.
module.businessContext: Supports generation or representation of web build nonces used in application security or cache/build identification. Failure yields an empty nonce and may invalidate downstream nonce-based behavior.
functions: buildNonce (~L8-46): Converts 22 bytes into a padded 24-character base64-like nonce.

sectionMap.name: alphabet declaration
sectionMap.intent: Defines the character lookup table used for encoded nonce positions.

sectionMap.intent: Rejects inputs that do not contain exactly 22 bytes.

sectionMap.intent: Maps input bytes into base64 index ranges with final-byte reduction.

sectionMap.name: alphabet conversion
sectionMap.intent: Converts masked numeric values into alphabet characters.

sectionMap.name: padding and return
sectionMap.intent: Appends base64 padding and returns the assembled nonce string.

edgeCases.inputShape: Uint8Array with fewer or more than 22 bytes
edgeCases.behavior: Returns an empty string without performing encoding.
Masks values before alphabet lookup, ensuring indexes remain within the intended ranges.
Returns a 24-character string consisting of 22 alphabet characters and two equals signs.

boundaryConditions.intent: Rejects every input length other than exactly 22 bytes.
Uses the six-bit mask for indexes zero through nineteen.

invariants.description: Only arrays with exactly 22 elements proceed to encoding.
The first 20 mapped values are restricted to six-bit base64 indexes.
The final two mapped values retain only the high two information bits.
A valid input produces 22 encoded characters followed by two padding characters.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies a Uint8Array whose contents are suitable for nonce generation.
Consumers expect the valid output to use a 24-character padded base64-like representation.

concurrencyModel.notes: The function performs only local immutable transformations and has no shared state or asynchronous work.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A byte array whose length is not 22 is supplied.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The function must reject inputs that do not contain exactly 22 bytes.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A 22-byte array containing only zero values is supplied.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Zero values must map to the first alphabet character and retain the two-character padding.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A 22-byte array containing only 255 values is supplied.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The first 20 bytes use six bits while the final two bytes use only the two leading bits.

moduleContractTests.rationale: Every valid input produces 22 alphabet characters followed by two padding characters.
